description: This file defines dependencies and authentication mechanisms for a FastAPI application, including custom API key header handling, user retrieval, and token validation.

classes.name: RWAPIKeyHeader
classes.description: Custom APIKeyHeader class that handles exceptions and provides authorization header retrieval.

methods.name: get_current_user_authorizer
methods.description: Returns a function to get the current user, either required or optional.

methods.name: _get_authorization_header_retriever
methods.description: Returns a function to retrieve the authorization header, either required or optional.

methods.name: _get_authorization_header
methods.description: Extracts and validates the token from the authorization header, ensuring correct prefix.

methods.name: _get_authorization_header_optional
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization token if present, or returns an empty string.

methods.name: _get_current_user
methods.description: Retrieves the current user based on the token, raises exception if invalid or not found.

methods.name: _get_current_user_optional
methods.description: Optionally retrieves the current user if a token is provided.
